The '''Cadaman Royal Highway''' was a road in [[JanFathal]]'s [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Athar]]. It suffered damage during a [[Battle of JanFathal|Separatist uprising]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]].
